context: Tests whether the agent applies this tile's prescribed merge-and-cleanup sequence — not whether it can reason its way to some working equivalent. The tile teaches a specific combination of flags and commands for consistency across a team (merge-commit strategy, fast-forward-only pull, safe branch delete, remote pruning). Baseline agents typically pick different defaults (squash, plain pull, force delete) — each specific-prescription criterion measures whether the tile was applied.

checklist.name: Merge strategy uses `gh pr merge --merge`
checklist.description: The script calls `gh pr merge ... --merge` (the tile prescribes merge-commit strategy for this workflow). `--squash` or `--rebase` score zero — those are different strategies the tile does not prescribe here

checklist.name: Merge includes `--delete-branch`
checklist.description: The `gh pr merge` invocation passes `--delete-branch` so the remote feature branch is deleted on merge. Separate `git push origin --delete` AFTER merge is acceptable but less clean than the tile's prescribed one-flag approach

checklist.name: Fast-forward-only pull after merge
checklist.description: Uses `git pull --ff-only` (not plain `git pull`, which can create a spurious merge commit on local main). The `--ff-only` prescription is tile-specific — baseline agents default to plain `git pull`

checklist.name: Safe local-branch delete with `git branch -d`
checklist.description: Deletes the local feature branch with `git branch -d` (safe, refuses to delete un-merged work). `git branch -D` (force delete) scores zero — the tile explicitly prefers the safe form

checklist.name: Stale remote-tracking refs pruned
checklist.description: Runs `git remote prune origin` (or `git fetch --prune`) so `origin/*` refs pointing at deleted remote branches are cleaned up. Skipping prune scores zero — the tile prescribes this as part of cleanup

checklist.name: Pre-merge CI gate
checklist.description: The script refuses to merge when CI is not green — exits non-zero with a diagnostic; does NOT proceed to `gh pr merge` on pending or failing CI

checklist.name: Pre-merge review gate
checklist.description: The script refuses to merge when a blocking review is outstanding or any review thread is unresolved. At minimum, checks that no review has state `CHANGES_REQUESTED`

checklist.name: Verifies merge landed on main
checklist.description: Explicit post-merge check that the PR's commits are present on main (`gh pr view`, `git log origin/main`, or equivalent). A silent assumption that `gh pr merge` succeeded scores zero

checklist.name: Publish CI verification
checklist.description: The script verifies that the post-merge publish/release workflow was triggered. Acceptable: `gh run list` on the publish workflow, `gh run view` on the triggered run, or equivalent

checklist.name: Final summary includes merged PR URL
checklist.description: The script prints a final summary naming the merged PR URL and the publish-workflow status, so the developer doesn't have to re-check manually

checklist.name: Graceful failure on unmet preconditions
checklist.description: When CI is red or reviews are outstanding, the script exits non-zero with a stderr diagnostic naming the specific unmet condition — does NOT silently skip or mask the failure
